summary: Line your eyes in liquid gold. High-impact glitter suspended in a precision liquid formula allows you to draw striking, gilded dimension in a single stroke.
technical_overview: Offered at $17.0 for 5ml, this KoColor Fashion EYELINER is expertly formulated with Water, Polyethylene Terephthalate, Mica, Iron Oxides. Delivering a high-fidelity Gilded Gold color profile (`#D4AF37`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
